in_sanskrit.name: Imtiyaj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Jewel in the crown
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Imtiyaj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Imtiyaj is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a name of divine origin, symbolizing the one who is a jewel in the crown of God. This name is revered in Hindu mythology and is believed to bestow courage, wisdom, and a strong sense of duty.
